0.original: Hayama appears to be deeply engrossed in surveying the seas.

24.original: Survey the designated spots and slay the ominous onibi.

48.original: Kami above! Y-You can't just sneak up on someone like that! Now, what is it you need? If you do not require anything, I ask that you kindly allow me to return to watch du─

49.original: Ah─at second glance, you appear to be far stronger than the average <hex:020946E948FF0548797572FF07456C657A656EFF094C616C6166656C6CFF084D69716F277465FF09526F65676164796EFF064175205261FF0948726F7468676172FF06566965726103>. Perhaps there is something you can help me with. Lately we've been seeing eerie flashing lights along the eastern coast of Sakazuki.

50.original: I-It is probably just the ships passing though this area but some of the men here are convinced it is an onibi. They are terrified. Would you go and have a look for us?

51.original: The lights were last spotted to the northwest of here. If it turns out to be an onibi, after all, please see that it is dispatched. I-I would go and take care of it myself, of course, but I simply cannot leave my post here.

52.original: To the northwest of here is where the lights were last spotted. Please go there and, if there truly is an onibi, see that it is dispatched.

53.original: Try as you might, you do not spot any ominous onibi.

54.original: So you mean to say there was no onibi─only tiny little fire sprites?

55.original: Hahahaha! I cannot wait to reveal the news to the others. They will feel so foolish for being frightened!

56.original: A reward, you say? Is the act of doing a kind deed for a fellow man not reward enough? Hahaha! I am just joking, of course. Here you go!
